title: X-DRS-Bundle header decoded before size check — no header size cap
rationale: Added maxBundleHeaderBytes=87381 constant (ceil(65535*4/3)) and len(encoded) guard at top of decodeBundle before base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString. Both mcp.go and a2a.go callers covered via shared package-private function.
variants_checked: mcp.go:decodeBundle — root cause fixed; a2a.go:a2aMiddleware — calls same decodeBundle, covered; decode.go — operates on already-decoded bundle fields
bypass_considered: Exactly maxBundleHeaderBytes+1 bytes: len check evaluates to 87382>87381=true, returns errBundleTooLarge before any allocation
test_note: TestDecodeBundleRejectsOversizedHeader and TestMCPMiddlewareRejectsBadRequestForOversizedHeader added to mcp_test.go; A2A path implicitly covered by shared decodeBundle
review_reason: The diff inserts a pre-allocation length guard as the first statement of decodeBundle, which is the earliest defensible point before base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString can allocate a proportional heap buffer — a root-cause fix. Both callers automatically benefit; no hunk falls outside the affected call graph. The errBundleTooLarge sentinel propagates through the existing 400-path.
